ownership.rho: Own independent public-API fixtures, exact storage/access contracts and database consistency.
ownership.sigma: Own actual internal access contract, v5 adapter, query planning, joins, temporal operators, reasoning and solver tests.

extraction.method: Go go/parser AST, go/format canonical rendering; every non-test access/*.go file in lexicographic path order
extraction.scope: All interface declarations including unexported propertyIndexProber; all named noninterface types, exported values and exported function signatures. Interface members retain embedding and direct method declarations.
extraction.drift_check: Re-extract sources at the consumer commit. Compare source SHA256, interface names/public flags, members, type definitions/aliases and exported sentinel/value declarations. A changed hash requires review even if signatures match.
extraction.consumer_internal_import: prohibited; fixture data only; sigma runs actual internal contract compile tests in sigma repository.

semantics.rule: Structural assertions may decline optional doors. used/ok/exact booleans have distinct meanings; unavailable must not become exact-empty.
ScanOpts, PropertyStats and RelCreate are aliases to rho graph types; sentinel identities must support errors.Is across adapter layers.
Tyla segment facts require strictly ascending relationship IDs, matching row feed order. Capability decline precedes the first batch. Storage order does not imply temporal precedence.
Preserve full histories and annotation pieces requested by sigma CompleteSnapshot. Rho does not evaluate box, Since/Until, joins or annotations.

Existing graphAccessProbe verifies signatures and empty graph reachability only; it is not behavioral acceptance and its NodeByIDAt ignores opts. Its assertions cover a subset of the complete manifest.

contract: ExAdjacencyCapability.ForEachExAdjacentRelID(nodeID types.NodeID, incoming bool, fn func(types.RelID) bool) error
contract_extensions.required_v5_mapping: Source histories must remain reachable across tiered shard changes/reimported lives. Current adjacency union ex-adjacency is a sound historical candidate superset; duplicate/unordered IDs need exact resolver filtering. Actual deletes/history endpoints keep both legs; old existing legs cannot be erased merely because they also look like move/undo residue. Valid-end bounds only prune where sound at the requested belief pin; ValidTo==validFrom counts, open/untimed rows and invalidated/unknown bounds remain candidates. Callback false/pin/retention refusals and node/relationship parity persist; neither candidate index certifies a cut.
required_tests: Deleted/reimported cross-shard node and relationship history, changed endpoints and old pins match timeline/state oracle.
Valid-end equal-boundary, open/untimed, retracted, reverse-order imported rows and stale generation/pin checks retain exact sets.
contract_extensions.ownership: rho exact storage/access/preservation; sigma/ai-soc adapter consumption in their repositories
contract_extensions.title: Retained tiered lives, ex-adjacency and valid-end candidates (4.51.2)

contract_extensions.required_v5_mapping: An accelerator answers the per-entity store read at the moment of each call, consulting live cache/overlay and re-pinning after commitGen changes; it is not a frozen graph-wide read, retention lease or certified cut. It is not concurrency-safe. Hold store lifecycle exclusion during reads and Release all iterator/transaction pins before callback or exclusion release; Close is idempotent Release and the next read can re-open. Graph effective scans buffer at most 256 candidate timelines per read-lock hold, emit outside locks and may pre-read up to255 unused candidates after false; by-ID first-occurrence order and declared relationship semantics remain. Explicit native/wrapper capability negotiation cannot bypass overridden row methods; memory/tiered retain ordinary fallback. Importer source quiescence still covers writes/imports/retention/DDL across the whole preflight.
required_tests: Per-entity oracle parity through pending overlay, commit/flush/Clear windows, deleted/reimported lives, duplicate IDs and chunk boundaries.
Callbacks mutate/reenter/early-stop with no open read transaction or iterator pins; wrapper overrides, sharded slots and unsupported fallback remain authoritative.
contract_extensions.ownership: rho exact storage/access/preservation; sigma/ai-soc adapter consumption in their repositories
contract_extensions.title: ReadSnapshot accelerator and chunked scans (4.51.3)

contract_extensions.required_v5_mapping: FlushesEveryMutation gates the optional badger-only hold. Caller holds exclusive graph mutation lock for each hold and performs DurableFlush before durable acknowledgement; Release does not flush. The configured pending bound can cause multiple intermediate flushes (negative disables it), and rollback restores end in a durable flush. Standalone writes stay synced; failure at group flush is ErrCommitNotDurable with the group already visible/committed in memory and retryable pending durability. GroupCommitCapability stays separate and unchanged. This timing/power-loss improvement does not create v5 atomic groups or private-write isolation from v4 timestamps or buffered rows.
required_tests: Bounded split group, rollback, failed flush/retry and concurrent standalone writes preserve errors.Is and documented before-return subset semantics; actual sync count/durable reopen are separate from atomicity.
contract_extensions.ownership: rho exact storage/access/preservation; sigma/ai-soc adapter consumption in their repositories
contract_extensions.title: SyncWrites durable commit group hold (4.51.3)

contract_extensions.required_v5_mapping: UndoRelationshipCreate is DeleteRelationship with the same typed errors/change record, but without ex-adjacency for never-committed creates. Scoped token0 uses plain undo. Core uses native/explicit wrapper declaration only; inherited hooks are refused and fallback DeleteRelationship remains sound with extra candidates. Tiered placement removal suppresses ex-legs for live moves, while genuine deletes retain both legs. Existing ex-adjacency keys have no origin proof and cannot be blindly cleaned because earlier deleted lives may still need them. V5 imports logical history/identity and declared provenance, not stale candidate keys as graph facts.
required_tests: Failed create, GraphTx/batch/import/ImportMerge undo and tiered cross-shard move leave no new false legs; real deletes retain old-cut endpoint completeness and wrapper/scoped failures preserve sentinels.
contract_extensions.ownership: rho exact storage/access/preservation; sigma/ai-soc adapter consumption in their repositories
contract_extensions.title: Undone creates and placement moves avoid false historical legs (4.51.3)

contract_extensions.required_v5_mapping: The CRC-protected open image is derived acceleration and trusted only if its header is the newest badger commit; missing/corrupt/old/foreign-write images fall back to full row rebuild. Writable rebuild repairs stale/missing label/type/adjacency keys before a future image; read-only rebuild repairs/writes no image and failed repair suppresses image. Clean-open corruption can surface when the row is read instead of during rebuild. Raw delete-only external writes can compact away and defeat newest-header detection; no raw-writer completeness claim. Restored NDV retains deleted earlier-session values (never decreases), dirty extrema still rescan, absent/disabled stats defer until first stats read and failed scan stays deferred. Relationship stats remove the actual old-row contribution rather than per-rel resident memos; tiered split-write stats remain exact but tiered capability decline is not zero. Import/export must validate actual source rows/semantics, preserve opaque raw evidence and not treat derived images, counts or sketches as certified truth.
required_tests: Clean-image/full-rebuild effective timeline and index parity, damaged/foreign/crashed/read-only cases, stale-key repair failure and LabelIndexOnDisk temporal envelopes.
Preserve/stat-price exact counts versus estimated NDV and dirty min/max after deletion/reopen; DisablePlannerStats/unsupported errors remain explicit; row codecs and migration findings remain stable.
contract_extensions.ownership: rho exact storage/access/preservation; sigma/ai-soc adapter consumption in their repositories
contract_extensions.title: Clean reopen image, stale-key repair and planner statistics (4.51.3)
